# Security policy

Report a vulnerability introduced by djrm through a private GitHub security
advisory for this repository. Do not open a public issue.

If the vulnerability is present in upstream Django, follow the
[Django security policy](https://www.djangoproject.com/security/) so the Django
security team can coordinate fixes across supported releases. After upstream
publishes a fixed LTS tag, djrm will generate and release the corresponding
`djrm` build.
